structured_output.what_is_happening: BELUGA, a 37-minute-old pump.fun coin already on PumpSwap, uses the old Beluga / 'polite cat' meme. It hit an ATH of about $394k mcap (GMGN ath_price) and was already down to $165k at trigger. A few minutes later, DexScreener's API showed it at about $125k, -45% over 5m, with liquidity down to about $30.7k. Trade flow looks strange: about 8,400 buys against 830 sells, and 6,206 unique buyers against 397 sellers, at roughly $45 per trade. Almost 6,000 holders in 36 minutes with top10 at only 2.3% fits micro-buy or volume-bot farming. Meanwhile a few larger sells are pushing the price down hard. I found no news catalyst and no indexed posts for the contract, and the website shows only the word 'Beluga'.

narrative.description: Beluga cat / polite cat is an old evergreen meme (2018 photo, Beluga YouTube channel). It has been launched many times on Solana, TON and Robinhood Chain. I found no current event that would make it newly relevant.
narrative.why_spreading: I found no organic catalyst. Activity looks driven by the fresh launch plus bot-like micro-buys. GMGN flags the project as a community takeover.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only BELUGA with real volume today. The X handle @Belugasolcoin looks like an older, reused account (GMGN: the dev's X account launched 3 tokens).
token_connection.competing_tokens: The older Beluga Cat token E63CDw... (from 2024, about $24k mcap). The @belugacatonsol community token. A copy BELUGA (5pyE9...) created 3 minutes later. Several dead pump.fun BELUGAs. A Robinhood Chain Beluga Cat whose dev allocation is held by the meme creator.

authenticity.evidence: Buyers outnumber sellers about 10:1, trades average about $45, and nearly 6k holders appeared in 36 minutes with a very flat top10. GMGN flags 23 bundlers, 11 snipers and a transfer-linked insider network of 6. Price is falling sharply even with 900 buys vs 126 sells in 5m, so a few large sellers are exiting into bot buys. There are no paid DexScreener boosts, but the profile was updated.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so a real KOL or community push may be happening that I missed.

structural_risks: Down about 68% from ATH within the first hour, and the 5m trend is sharply negative
Liquidity of about $31k is shrinking; SOL is draining out of the pool
Holder count and buy count look inflated by bots
23 bundlers and a 6-wallet insider transfer network
LP is burned (100%), so a classic LP pull is unlikely, but the pair can still bleed out and die

The coin had enough buyers to reach $394k in about 20 minutes, and the LP is burned. A CTO community could defend it, and it could bounce off a $100k base back above $250k (2x) if a KOL or trending listing brings in new money. Sell pressure could be one-off early-sniper exits.
